Ui.Script:
function Lea_InputScrollFrame_OnLoad(self) local name = self:GetName() if not name then return end
local scrollBar = _G[name .. "ScrollBar"] local editBox = _G[name .. "EditBox"] self.ScrollBar = scrollBar self.EditBox = editBox self.CharCount = _G[name .. "CharCount"]
if scrollBar then scrollBar:ClearAllPoints() scrollBar:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", self, "TOPRIGHT", 6, -16) scrollBar:SetPoint("BOTTOMLEFT", self, "BOTTOMRIGHT", 6, 16) scrollBar:Hide() end
if editBox then editBox.Instructions = _G[editBox:GetName() .. "Instructions"] local w = self:GetWidth() if w and w > 18 then editBox:SetWidth(w - 18) end end end
function Lea_InputScrollFrame_OnSizeChanged(self) if self.EditBox then local w = self:GetWidth() if w and w > 18 then self.EditBox:SetWidth(w - 18) end end end
function Lea_InputScrollFrame_OnMouseDown(self) local editBox = self.EditBox or _G[self:GetName() .. "EditBox"] if editBox then editBox:SetFocus() end end
function Lea_InputScrollFrame_OnEscapePressed(self) self:ClearFocus() end
function Lea_InputScrollFrame_OnTabPressed(self) self:ClearFocus() end
function Lea_InputScrollFrame_OnTextChanged(self) local parent = self:GetParent() if parent and parent.UpdateScrollChildRect then parent:UpdateScrollChildRect() end end
function Lea_InputScrollFrame_OnUpdate(self, elapsed) ScrollingEdit_OnUpdate(self, elapsed, self:GetParent()) end
function Lea_InputScrollFrame_OnScrollRangeChanged(self, xrange, yrange) local scrollBar = self.ScrollBar or _G[self:GetName() .. "ScrollBar"] if not scrollBar then return end if not yrange then yrange = self:GetVerticalScrollRange() end local value = scrollBar:GetValue() if value > yrange then value = yrange end scrollBar:SetMinMaxValues(0, yrange) if scrollBar:GetValue() ~= value then scrollBar:SetValue(value) end if math.floor(yrange) == 0 then scrollBar:Hide() else scrollBar:Show() end end
function Lea_InputScrollFrame_OnVerticalScroll(self, value) local parent = self:GetParent() if parent then parent:SetVerticalScroll(value) end end
function Lea_InputScrollFrame_OnMouseWheel(self, delta) local scrollBar = self.ScrollBar or (self:GetParent() and self:GetParent().ScrollBar) if not scrollBar or not scrollBar:IsShown() then return end local cur = scrollBar:GetValue() local minVal, maxVal = scrollBar:GetMinMaxValues() local step = 18 if delta > 0 then scrollBar:SetValue(math.max(minVal, cur - step)) else scrollBar:SetValue(math.min(maxVal, cur + step)) end end
